item.title: Woman sentenced and banned from Hotel Chocolat in Nottingham

item.description: Rushcliffe Borough Council’s (RBC) Council Tax is set to be frozen for 2026/27 and to remain the lowest in Nottinghamshire for the borough council element of the bill, despite a poor financial settlement from central government. item.title: Overnight resurfacing works on Queens Drive progressing ahead of month of lane closures
item.description: Resurfacing works are taking place on Queens Drive between Crossgate Drive and Castle Bridge Road, with overnight closures and restrictions.
